title: NoteLama · Your notebooks. Your storage.
description: NoteLama is an offline notebook app in development for iPad and Android tablets, with reading and editing on phones.
headline: Your notebooks. Your storage.
intro: A notebook app for handwritten ideas and the paper you want to keep. Designed for iPad and Android tablets, with your phone close at hand.
writeBody: Organize books, write with a pen, zoom into details and undo a mistake. Read and edit on your phone, too.
scanBody: Scan a document or bring in a photo, then add notes directly on the page.
storageBody: Work offline. Optional sync is planned through iCloud on Apple, Google Drive on Android and Nextcloud on both.
note: NoteLama is not available for download yet. This page describes the planned app.
footer: NoteLama · A notebook, wherever you need it.
scriptNotice: JavaScript enables the language switch. The English page is available without it.
